char.name: Peep
char.bio: The runt, and the deadliest at range. Sits chin-deep in the water channels -- he breathes it fine -- and picks off anyone wading across while his brothers hold the bank.

char.name: Ribit
char.bio: The eldest of the three and the one who does the talking. Fast, never where the blow lands, and fond of letting you tire yourself out in the open before the dagger finds your throat.

char.name: Bufo
char.bio: The big brother. Plants himself between you and the flag and does not move -- a wall of warty muscle with a broadsword in his fists and a spear on his tongue.
